content: Standard 2026 pattern for Sign in with Google in a React SPA: load Google Identity Services (GIS) script, render the Sign In With Google button/One Tap, receive a signed JWT credential (ID token) client-side, POST it to a backend endpoint, then verify signature/aud/exp/iss server-side using Google's public keys before trusting it. Never trust the token client-side. Use the ID token's 'sub' claim (not email) as the stable user identifier.
